title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Routine follow-up for type 2 diabetes.

History of Present Illness
The patient presents for follow-up regarding their type 2 diabetes. They report adherence to their current management plan, emphasizing diet and exercise. They deny any recent changes in diet or activity level. Physical examination reveals stable status. Review of systems is negative for new complaints. The patient understands the importance of maintaining a diet controlled approach to managing their type 2 diabetes. They confirm they have no complications related to their type 2 diabetes.

Medication List
None.

Exam
Vitals stable. Skin exam normal. Cardiovascular exam within normal limits.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus: Stable. Managed with diet and exercise, and currently presenting with no complications.

Plan
Continue current management plan. Patient is advised to continue with diet and exercise to maintain a diet controlled approach for their type 2 diabetes. Follow up as scheduled.
explanations: No complication is documented: type 2 diabetes without complications.

distractors.why: Nothing in the note documents hyperglycemia or poor control.
